overall_limitations: Several rubric entries are split across claims. Gold IDs above require an individual claim to adequately state the complete entry; an empty gold_ids array does not imply the claim is false.

The claims omit transaction-start end-mark fixation, shared-memory lookup and its same-host restriction, the one-writer limit, NOOP's status-query purpose, and attached-database error continuation rules.
Performance coverage omits the lookup-cost mechanism, explicit checkpoint-induced COMMIT latency and the read/write scheduling tradeoff.
The packet contains conflicting general and API-specific statements about reader blocking. The submitted mode claims accurately follow S2's explicit API descriptions.
Three listed concepts are unresearched surrounding topics, not additional claim-supported concepts. No claim duplicates an earlier claim with the same specifics.
A single reported extraction pass establishes neither depth saturation nor independent corroboration; all supplied sources share one origin.
